title: Meta quietly launched an ‘AI pet journal’ app
script:
Meta just launched Waddle World, a virtual pet game where creatures chat and create doodles.
Apple and Play Store listings reveal the sixteen-bit pet care experience is actually a daily journal disguised as a pet.
Users talk instead of typing to interact with their virtual creature on the Meta app.
The tamagotchi-style creatures illustrate conversations by drawing doodles for their owners.
Would you trust a Meta pet to keep your daily journal?
